parts.name: ToastProvider
parts.description: Holds the list of toasts and their timers. Inside it, `(use toast).toasts` is the list to render (newest first) and `(use toast).manager` adds, updates and closes toasts. What the manager is told lands in a change of its own, a microtask after the call, so a toast added from inside an action (`await manager.promise(save())`) shows at once rather than when the action ends. A toast's `onClose` and `onRemove` are called the same way.

props.name: timeout
props.description: How long a toast stays before it closes by itself, in ms, unless it was added with its own `timeout`. `0` keeps toasts until they are closed.

props.name: limit
props.description: How many toasts show at once. Older ones stay in the list, inert and with `data-limited`, until the ones in front close.

props.name: toastManager
props.description: A manager made with `createToastManager()`, for adding toasts from outside the provider. Read once. Without it the provider makes its own.

parts.name: ToastViewport
parts.description: The element the toasts are rendered in: a `popover="manual"` shown while it is mounted, so it is in the top layer, and a polite live region labelled "Notifications". It comes with the browser's popover styles: give it a position. Hovering it or moving keyboard focus into it expands the stack and pauses the timers; F6 moves focus to it while there are toasts.

dataAttributes.name: data-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the viewport or keyboard focus is in it.

cssVariables.name: --toast-frontmost-height
cssVariables.description: The height of the newest toast that isn't closing, in px. Set once it has been measured.

parts.name: ToastRoot
parts.description: One toast, for one entry of `(use toast).toasts`. It closes after its timeout, on Escape while focus is in it, and when swiped past the threshold. A toast added with `priority: "high"` gets the `alertdialog` role.

props.name: toast
props.description: The toast to render: an entry of `(use toast).toasts`.

props.name: swipeDirection
props.description: The directions a swipe closes it in, one or several. Movement the other way is damped. `[]` turns swiping off.

props.name: swipeThreshold
props.description: How far a swipe must travel to close the toast, in px. A shorter one snaps back.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the toast animates out. It stays in the list until the transitions and animations on it and its descendants finish.

dataAttributes.name: data-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Present while the stack is expanded: the pointer is over the viewport or keyboard focus is in it.

dataAttributes.name: data-limited
dataAttributes.description: Present on toasts beyond the provider's `limit`. They are inert; hide them.

dataAttributes.name: data-swipe-direction
dataAttributes.description: The direction the toast is being swiped in, and after a swipe that closed it, the one it left in. Absent otherwise.

dataAttributes.name: data-swiping
dataAttributes.description: Present while the toast is being dragged.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The `type` the toast was added with, such as `success` or `loading`.

cssVariables.name: --toast-index
cssVariables.description: The toast's position among those that aren't closing, newest first, from 0. A closing toast keeps its place in the whole list.

cssVariables.name: --toast-offset-y
cssVariables.description: The heights of the toasts in front of it added up, in px: where it sits when the stack is spread out.

cssVariables.name: --toast-height
cssVariables.description: The toast's own height, in px, measured as if no `height` were set on it.

cssVariables.name: --toast-swipe-movement-x
cssVariables.description: How far the toast has been dragged sideways, in px. Back to `0px` when a short swipe snaps back.

cssVariables.name: --toast-swipe-movement-y
cssVariables.description: How far the toast has been dragged up or down, in px.

parts.name: ToastContent
parts.description: Holds a toast's text and buttons, so they can be hidden on the toasts behind the front one while the stack is collapsed.

dataAttributes.name: data-behind
dataAttributes.description: Present on every toast but the newest.

dataAttributes.name: data-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Present while the stack is expanded.

parts.name: ToastTitle
parts.description: A heading that names the toast: its children, or else the `title` the toast was added with. Renders nothing when it has neither. The toast's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The `type` the toast was added with.

parts.name: ToastDescription
parts.description: A paragraph that describes the toast: its children, or else the `description` it was added with. Renders nothing when it has neither. The toast's `aria-describedby` points at it.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The `type` the toast was added with.

parts.name: ToastAction
parts.description: A button for the toast's action. It takes the toast's `actionProps`, with their `children` as its label, and then its own props. Renders nothing without a label.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The `type` the toast was added with.

parts.name: ToastClose
parts.description: A button that closes the toast. It is hidden from assistive technology while the stack is collapsed, unless it has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The `type` the toast was added with.
